service-call.name: mantle.ledger.FiscalRegisterServices.get#VatRegisterData

set.from: '/apps/Accounting/Tax/VatRegisters?' + Object.entries(Object.assign({renderMode: 'html-print'}, {organizationPartyId:organizationPartyId, registerType:registerType, fiscalYear:fiscalYear, timePeriodId:timePeriodId, fromDate:fromDate, thruDate:thruDate, vatRegisterSeries:vatRegisterSeries})).filter(entry => entry[1]).map(entry => entry[0] + '=' + encodeURIComponent(entry[1])).join('&')
